khoon.name: Khoon
khoon.origin: Khoon was an explorer for an unknown alien race from an unnamed alternate dimension. After he conquered the entirety of his own dimension he traveled through the Dimensional Corridor to discover more. However, his ship wasn't built to travel through the Corridor and broke down beyond repair. Khoon used the remains of the ship to build Wolf Pack and wandered the Corridor for millennia looking for a way to breach the portals to other dimensions. He came into contact with Galactus, Silver Surfer, Dr. Strange, and Nova and sent his Wolf Pack to disable it. Surfer and Nova went to stop the Wolf Pack but were unable to claim a clear victory over the Wolf Pack. Khoon confronted the pair and severed Nova's connection the ship and threatened to throw her into the corridor if they didn't let him on board. Khoon was allowed onboard and threatened Galactus with destruction, but when Khoon revealed he had maps of the Corridor, Galactus had his ship retrieve them from his armor, killing Khoon.

khora moira vii 1.name: Khora (Moira-VII.1)
khora moira vii 1.origin: ===Year 1=== After the Quiet Council of Sinisters provoked a new war between the Eternals and the mutant nations of Krakoa and Arakko, Khora fought alongside Uranos and her family. ===Year 5=== Khora fought against Sinister's forces alongside the Brotherhood of Arakko in the war between Krakoa and Arakko. She survived the fight, unlike many other Arakkii and Arakko was destroyed. ===Year 10=== thumb|left Khora joined Storm's Brotherhood of Mutants and started living on Asteroid S. When Mystique revealed that Sinister possessed a machine that resets reality via Clones of Moira MacTaggert, the group went to Muir Island to retrieve it, but Mystique betrayed them impersonating Wiz Kid, backstabbed Storm and took the engine with her. ===Year 100=== 90 years later, the remnants of Storm's brotherhood, Khora included, survived on a satellite drifting in space, still carrying on their resistance against the Sinisters. They were once again approached by Destiny, whose wife Mystique had long since been killed in action fighting the Sinisters. Without her wife, Destiny saw no meaning to carrying on this timeline, and came before an aged Storm to offer her services in reaching the Moira Engine. The group launched an assault on the World Farm where the engine was kept, with Khora using her powers to boost Destiny, allowing her to guide them past the Farm's defenses. However, Storm double-crossed Destiny, resolved to continue to fight for the timeline rather than undo it. With Khora's aid, Storm unleashed her powers and disabled the World Farm's defenses, but rather than destroy it, she had her brotherhood steal it, before dying from the strain in Khora's arms. ===Year 1000=== Now led by Jon Ironfire, the Brotherhood had turned the World Farm into an impregnable fortress, which they had defended against a universe of horrors for nearly a millennium. One day, Mr. Sinister, having spent 900 years searching for the Moira Engine, crashed onto the World Farm, pursued by an armada loyal to Emma Frost. After requesting Jon's help, Sinister used stolen genetic material of Storm and Hope Summers, together with a new Five, with Khora playing the role of Hope, to clone Storm, though without her original memories. As the armada descended on them, Khora boosted the new Storm's powers just as she had before, allowing her to destroy the armada. Though the Arakkii were victorious, Khora lost her life in the battle.
powers: Khora has the same powers as her Earth-616 counterpart.
abilities: Khora has the same abilities as her Earth-616 counterpart.

khordes.name: Khordes
khordes.origin: Khordes was a satyr who cursed Earth sea-pirate Captain Fate to sail the spaceways forever aboard the Serpent's Crown after the ship's former captain, Maura Hawke, stabbed him. He was resurrected by the Man-Thing and lifted the curse after Hawke's reincarnation Maura Spinner decided to stay with him. He used to live in the Bermuda Triangle, but left the Earthly Plane with his mortal bride. He returned once to fight Captain Fate.

khosatral khel.name: Khosatral Khel
khosatral khel.origin: ===Origins=== Khosatral Khel was the demon offspring of the aquatic monster and possible Great Old One or degenerated god Dagon. He allegedly extracted himself from darkness and the abyss to exist in substance of the material universe. As human flesh was too frail to hold his essence, he crafted from matter a body, a blasphemy against nature. For thousand years, he went through the world, where he was attacked (but couldn't be harmed) by the humans. ===Dagonia=== Eventually, he came across the primitive inhabitants of the island of Dagonia (later known as Xapur), and he gave them culture and civilization as he was pleased to so. Aided by him, they built the city of Dagonia. thumb|right|450px|Khosatral Khel's "human" form He was worshipped by the Dagonites or Dagonians. His house was connected to every other in the city, so his priests could always bring him victims as sacrifice. At some point, the brutish people self-styled Yuetshi came on the shore of Dagonia. After a fierce battle, the Yuetshi were defeated by Khosataral Khel, and became slaves, serving as sacrifices on the altar for nearly a generation. ===Dagonia's destruction=== It was hypothesized that those events occurred circa 17,100-16,900 BC (within a century or so from G.C. 1500, or 1500 years after the Great Cataclysm): a Yuetshi priest went into wilderness, and later returned with a knife forged of a meteor. Upon his return, the Yuetshi slaves revolted against their Dagonian masters, slaughtering them. Before that knife, Khosatral Khel's magic was impotent. Allegedly, it was the magic of Khosatral Khel repelled the Yuetshi from the walls. The priest then faced Khosatral Khel and stabbed him with the knife. That way, the god wasn't slain but remained senseless and unmoving, and the priest used that state to threaten to revive him in case of rebellion. ===Age of Conan (10,000 BC)=== Some Yuetshi invoked Khosatral's name. ====Return==== Years later, a Yuetshi fisherman went on Xapur the Fortified (Dagonia), and removed the knife from Khosatral Khel's chest, breaking the spell. The god killed the fisherman, then restored his city and its inhabitants using necromancy. Khosatral Khel later captured Octavia, and battled Conan when he came to retrieve the woman. He then turned against Jehungir Agha and his men, came to kill Conan, leaving only Jehungir Agha on the island. As Conan slew Jehungir Agha, Khosatral Khel was back upon them. Using the magic dagger he had retrieved, Conan stabbed the god and killed him. As he died, his body returned to his original and repugnant form, while Dagonia shifted back to the ruins of Xapur.

khossus v.name: Khossus V
khossus v.origin: ===Origins=== Khossus V was the monarch of of Koth, circa 13,000 BC, at the end of Age of Acheron. ===Fall of Acheron=== After Koth took its independence from Acheron, Khossus V formed a grand alliance with fledgling Ophir, the Hybori tribes, and all who hated Acheron, marching of the Acheronian capital of Python from the east, and precipitating the Fall of Acheron. During the sack of Python, Khossus V took the magical gem known as the Blood of Bel-Hissar from a dying wizard. ===Afterwards=== He founded Khorshemish upon ruins already there. There, his men digging cellars for the palace found a walled-up doorway which they broke into. The Grand Vizier died in the pits beyond the doorway in circumstances that led Khossus to have the pits walled up again and the palace abandoned. Khossus then built another palace in the suburbs, but fled it as well upon discovering some black mold having appeared on its marble floor one morning.

khufor.name: Khufor
khufor.origin: thumb|left|126px|Pharaoh Amenhotep ===Pharaoh Amenhotep=== Khufor ruled ancient Egypt in the 30th century BC as the Pharaoh Amenhotep when the Tribe of Gurban and their leader Ribur invaded his kingdom. He was able to defeat the attackers with the help of adventurer Dynaman. He had two children: Ozymandias and Nephri. He was overthrown by the time traveler Rama-Tut. Rama-Tut dealt with Khufor by turning him into the vampire Amenhotep, using the nectar of the undead, and sealing him away in a pyramid. 5000 years later, the Swordsman entered the pyramid in search of the Avengers, after they were captured by Rama-Tut's counterpart Kang the Conqueror, and was attacked by Amenhotep. Swordsman fought the vampire off until Egyptian soldiers came in and became Amenhotep's victims instead, allowing Swordsman to escape. After killing all of the soldiers, Amenhotep ventured outside of the pyramid and was killed from exposure from sunlight. Amenhotep was later brought back to life by the Grim Reaper by transforming a hostage into a copy of him using the powers of the demon Lloigoroth as part of his Legion of the Unliving in order to avenge his death against the Avengers. Amenhotep and the rest of the Legion battled the Avengers in another dimension. Amenhotep and Grim Reaper briefly fought the Vision until Vision reminded Grim Reaper that the Avengers didn't kill him, but he had actually committed suicide. Grim Reaper's confidence was shaken by this fact, causing his hold on Amenhotep and the rest of the Legion to falter. The Legion then prepared to attack Grim Reaper until he was consumed by the demon Lloigoroth. With Grim Reaper gone, the Legion, including Amenhotep, returned to the afterlife.
weaknesses: Like all vampires, Amenhotep was vulnerable to sunlight.

khult.name: Khult
khult.origin: Khult was a Deviant from the planet Tebbel. His was the first new world conquered by Lord Tantalus after he enslaved his own world of Armechadon. Khult was spared by the conqueror in part because of his daughter, Nirvana. Nirvana was the product of centuries of genetic breeding to produce a stable line of Deviants. A side-effect was that Nirvana was immune to the lethal "Black Legacy" of Tantalus's touch. Seeing the opportunity to produce heirs long denied him, Tantalus took Nirvana as his bride and Khult as his confidant and court sorcerer. After conquering four more worlds, Tantalus and Khult were trapped on Earth with a band of followers by the Celestials thousands of years ago. Tantalus believed they were marooned on the undeveloped world because their stardrive was broken, and the trip back to Armechadon would take too long. Khult advised they wait until Earth's level of technology reached the point where they could harness its tech for their own purposes. Secretly, however, Khult's sorcery allowed him to travel home to Armechadon at will, and he set himself up as the Dark Lord.
powers: Khult was a Deviant magician who had lived for thousands of years.

family: Pelops (grandson, deceased) Lucian (grandson) Id (grandson) Unnamed grandson

khup.name: Khup
khup.origin: Khup was a warrior of the Aerians, a genetically-engineered race of winged humanoids (bird-people) who lived in Pangea, a region of Antarctica that was adjacent to the Savage Land. Like most (or all) of his people, Khup resided in their single city, Aerie Shalan. By the time that the Aerians first met and became allies with Ka-Zar, Shanna the She-Devil and Zabu, Khup was a trained warrior who was serving the Aerie's leader, Lord M'Dom Typ, as his First Lieutenant. However, although Lord Typ trusted Khup, that trust was misplaced because Khup was secretly a member of a faction of the Aerian population who wanted to overthrow the kingdom and assassinate Typ. Shortly after the Aerians had, with the help of their new allies, won a decisive victory over their long-time enemies, the Pterons, the conspirators decided to make their move. Knowing that a kelta tournament would be part of the celebration and that Lord Typ would be expected to lead one of the two teams to victory, they plotted to fix the games by making sure that the opposing team was made up of their members. Since Typ's team wore blue arm bands, the opposing team wore red arm bands. At some point, the wooden swords of the Red team were all secretly dipped in a mild drug that would non-fatally incapacitate anyone cut by them, presumably to prevent those Aerians loyal to Typ from resisting. However, one sword was dipped in snake venom so that it could be used to kill Typ. All the members of the Red team knew of this but none of them were told whose sword was the murder weapon. As the kelta continued past sundown, now lit by torchlight, Lord Typ noticed that members of his team who fell weren't getting up again. At that point, Khup signaled to Typ and informed him that one of Typ's physicians had discovered a drug in the blood of the fallen Blue warriors, something that Typ had strictly forbidden. Khup also informed Typ that one of the captured Red bands, Chan, had something he had to hear. At the field hospital, Khup stood by while Chan told Typ that he had been injured by his own team who were plotting to overthrow the kingdom and that Typ was to be killed by a poisoned sword but that the identity of the would-be assassin had been kept secret. After hearing this, Typ sent Khup to summon Lord Ka-Zar and Shanna and those Aerians who had been with him the longest, and Khup left to do so. Khup found Ka-Zar just as Dephine, who wished to become Ka-Zar's lover, revealed to him that she had sent Shanna far away to a private island by putting her on a hoxing skite. Khup interrupted them and told Ka-Zar that he had brought that skite from the island of Nahgen, that hoxing skites would return to their birthplace no matter what, and that the island of Nahgen had sunk six days earlier so the skite would circle the area until it fell into the sea, potentially drowning both it and its rider, Shanna. At that moment, both Lord Typ and his wife Wena arrived and Typ told Ka-Zar about the plot to kill him by an assassin wielding a poisoned blade. When Buth, Dephine's jealous boyfriend who had been very publicly beaten by Ka-Zar in an arena match earlier in the day, arrived with his wooden sword and attacked Ka-Zar, Typ, Ka-Zar, Dephine and Wena all assumed that he was the assassin. However, after being defeated by Ka-Zar, Buth was clearly puzzled when Ka-Zar accused him of plotting to kill his own ruler. At that moment, Khup made his move, stabbing Typ with the poisoned sword, but his victory was short-lived because Ka-Zar then used his sling to dispose of the traitor, hurling a stone into the back of his head as he attempted to flee. Lord Typ survived long enough to use his last moments to ask Buth to promise to help Ka-Zar restore the kingdom, and then said good-bye to Ka-Zar.
abilities: Skilled winged warrior
weapons: Wooden sword dipped in snake venom
weaknesses: Vulnerable to attack if his wings were damaged.

As the kelta continued past sundown, now lit by torchlight, Lord Typ noticed that members of his team who fell weren't getting up again. At that point, Khup signaled to Typ and informed him that one of Typ's physicians had discovered a drug in the blood of the fallen Blue warriors, something that Typ had strictly forbidden. Khup also informed Typ that one of the captured Red bands, Chan, had something he had to hear. At the field hospital, Khup stood by while Chan told Typ that he had been injured by his own team who were plotting to overthrow the kingdom and that Typ was to be killed by a poisoned sword but that the identity of the would-be assassin had been kept secret. After hearing this, Typ sent Khup to summon Lord Ka-Zar and Shanna and those Aerians who had been with him the longest, and Khup left to do so. Khup found Ka-Zar just as Dephine, who wished to become Ka-Zar's lover, revealed to him that she had sent Shanna far away to a private island by putting her on a hoxing skite. Khup interrupted them and told Ka-Zar that he had brought that skite from the island of Nahgen, that hoxing skites would return to their birthplace no matter what, and that the island of Nahgen had sunk six days earlier so the skite would circle the area until it fell into the sea, potentially drowning both it and its rider, Shanna. At that moment, both Lord Typ and his wife Wena arrived and Typ told Ka-Zar about the plot to kill him by an assassin wielding a poisoned blade. When Buth, Dephine's jealous boyfriend who had been very publicly beaten by Ka-Zar in an arena match earlier in the day, arrived with his wooden sword and attacked Ka-Zar, Typ, Ka-Zar, Dephine and Wena all assumed that he was the assassin. However, after being defeated by Ka-Zar, Buth was clearly puzzled when Ka-Zar accused him of plotting to kill his own ruler. At that moment, Khup made his move, stabbing Typ with the poisoned sword, but his victory was short-lived because Ka-Zar then used his sling to dispose of the traitor, hurling a stone into the back of his head as he attempted to flee. Lord Typ survived long enough to use his last moments to ask Buth to promise to help Ka-Zar restore the kingdom, and then said good-bye to Ka-Zar.
abilities: Skilled winged warrior
weaknesses: Vulnerable to attack if his wings were damaged.
weapons: Wooden sword dipped in snake venom
fields.notes: Aside from the fact that they wanted to overthrow the kingdom and kill Typ, nothing has ever been revealed about the conspiracy of which Khup was a member, including their name for their group and the motivations for their actions. The fact that Chan was able to tell Lord Typ about the plot while Khup was standing right there suggests that none of the "Red bands" knew that Khup was a member of the conspiracy. Although Khup was not shown to be dead after Ka-Zar's stone struck him in the back of his head, the fact that the writer described the weapon Ka-Zar used as his "lethal sling" is a strong indication that Khup's injury was fatal. Similarly, although Lord Typ was not shown to have actually died after speaking his last words to Ka-Zar, in the Ka-Zar does speak of how Khup had killed the Aerian ruler. Like many (but not all) Aerians, Khup's feathers were the same color as his skin and his hair.

khyber.name: Khyber
khyber.origin: The mysterious cybernetic being known as Khyber, sharing an enigmatic history with Logan, stood armed to the teeth with his own bionic enhancements and a small cadre of mercenaries who did his bidding. He privately owned his own cache of Adamantium which was nicked by the Hellfire Club's former White King, Donald Pierce. Donald used the Adamantium in conjunction with future technology sitting at one of Cable's safe houses to perfect a newly created cyborg body for himself. Khyber mobilized his forces to demolish the arctic reservation while dealing with the thief personally, leaving with one of Pierce's arms and whats left of his upper body while imparting a cryptic warning to Wolverine on his lips as he teleported away after the battle. Wolverine would later receive a tip regarding a stolen cache of adamantium, only to discover Khyber's body at the scene of the crime.

kid clayton.name: Kid Clayton
kid clayton.first_appearance: Marvel Westerns: The Two-Gun Kid Vol 1 1
kid clayton.origin: Little is known of the western adventurer known as Kid Clayton's past prior to his coming to Tombstone, Texas, in 1876. While in Tombstone, Clayton and his sidekick Nantan were investigating a case of cattle rustlers stealing local ranchers' steer. Clayton determined that the culprits were Jeb Barker and his boys. During a skirmish, Clayton noticed a large wolf-shaped scar on one of the men's chests. He had recognized this scar and realized that he was dealing with something more than just ordinary cattle rustlers, and they bore the mark of the werewolf. Clayton must have had experience dealing with werewolves at some point in the past, as he carried a supply of silver bullets which he used to try and help him bring the Barker's to justice. A few nights later, Clayton and Nantan traveled into the desolate area known only as the Dead Lands in pursuit of their supernatural cattle rustlers. They were unprepared, however, for what waited for them. There were five werewolves and a pack of wolves under their command. Kid Clayton was overwhelmed by wolves in the resulting battle and was killed. Nantan was also badly wounded, but managed to survive, though he had inherited the curse of the werewolf. The next day, the Two-Gun Kid passed through the Dead Lands and saw a large pile of dead wolves. Upon further inspection, he found a badly injured Nantan, and the body of Kid Clayton, which he buried. Later, the Kid discovered why Kid Clayton had been using silver bullets and dug up his body in order to get his ammunition so that he could slay the werewolves responsible.
abilities: Kid Clayton was a skilled gunfighter and horseman.
weapons: Pistols. Kid Clayton was also familiar with dealing with werewolves and carried a supply of silver bullets in order to deal with the supernatural menaces if needed.

kikyo mikage.name: Kikyo Mikage
kikyo mikage.origin: Kikyo Mikage is a Mutant and a ronin mercenary who shares a rivalry with both Wolverine and Blade respectively, possessing a healing factor and retractable blades like the former and is a master swordsman like the latter. Although his origins are unknown, even to himself, he was taken in as a child under the sword master Tanba Yagyu, and would later train alongside Eric Brooks before he became known as the vampire hunter "Blade". Kikyo, who was equally skilled but arrogant, was only concerned with winning, a fault which his master called him out for. After two years of Yagyu's training, Eric decided to leave to continue his training with Noah van Helsing, but Kikyo refused to let him leave without one last duel to determine which of them was the strongest. However, he suffered a quick and humiliating defeat by Eric, and while Kikyo demanded for his rival to take his head, Eric said he already lost it. After training under Yagyu for another two years, Kikyo was sent packing as Yagyu claimed he had nothing more to teach him and that Kikyo needed to see the real world. Although he was reluctant, he accepted his master's wishes and was grateful that he took him in. He wasn't aware that Yagyu had been diagnosed with a lethal form of lung cancer. Some point afterward, Kikyo had been hired as an assassin of Shingen Harada, the head of the Kuzuryu yakuza gang, who was affiliated with A.I.M.. In Tokyo, after Logan and Yukio discovered that his longtime friend Tesshin Asano had been killed and were set up in his murder, Kikyo appeared before them. Possessing the same healing factor as Logan and using a sword hidden in his right arm similar to Wolverine's claws, Kikyo quickly proved to be a devastating opponent and would have killed his newfound rival if not for Logan's own healing factor. Logan later suspected that Kikyo was Asano's killer and swore revenge, but police intervention forced them both to withdrawal. Kikyo seemed impressed that Logan lasted against him, which made him determined to see which of them was the strongest. Logan later returned to Shingen's hideout in another attempt to save Mariko, but only discovered Kikyo instead, who denied that he had any involvement in Asano's death. The two fought throughout Tokyo once more, only to be interrupted by Omega Red, who Logan had already fought earlier. Kikyo stood back and allowed the two to fight, but upon the Russian's defeat, he decided to depart from the scene, telling Logan there was no honor in fighting an exhausted opponent and would fight him again when he was well and rested. Kikyo later followed Logan to Madripoor, confronting him once again just before he and Yukio could reach Hideki Kurohagi's palace, where Mariko was being held and who she was being forced to marry. Realizing what Logan was really after, Kikyo deducted that it would be an honorless fight if Logan's mind was on his goal and not the battle, and decided to put their fight on hold, even after Kurohagi ordered him to kill Logan anyway. Kurohagi then had a revitalized Vadhaka take over and fight Logan, Yukio, and Koh's resistance movement. When Min put herself in harm's way and was nearly gunned down by Shingen's men, Kikyo sliced their guns to pieces, declaring that only cowards use guns and are worse if they're used against children. He later aided Logan when Min was fatally struck by the animated statue, revealing another sword hidden in his left arm that he fought the beast with. thumb|left|260px|Kikyo about to attack Following Vadhaka's defeat and angered by Min's death, Kikyo joined Logan and Yukio in their fight against Shingen's forces, stating that he has business with them as well, but reminded Logan of their impending duel after he was done saving Mariko. When Logan confronted Shingen, who derided Kikyo for not killing him, Kikyo reminded his client that he'd only fight Logan on equal terms. Shingen terminated his contract, stating he'd gladly finish the job himself. When Logan and Shingen duel for the last time, Kurohagi attempted to shoot his distracted enemy with his special poison weapon again. Kikyo however took the hit and attempts to suck the poison out before it can kill him, refusing to let Kurohagi interfere. He watched Logan and Shingen duel alongside a mortally wounded Yukio, who finally got her chance to avenge her parents. After Shingen is killed and Yukio succumbed to her injuries, he helped Logan reach the catacombs where Kurohagi was hiding with Mariko. Kikyo held the closing door, allowing Logan to get through, ending his participation in the fight. After the battle, he and Logan faced off again in an empty field at night, fighting to determine which of them is the strongest. Logan would remain in Madripoor to investigate AIM's activities. He later came across Blade and his partner, the vampire hunter Makoto, who were investigating their involvement with Deacon Frost and Existence. fields.history: Kikyo Mikage is a Mutant and a ronin mercenary who shares a rivalry with both Wolverine and Blade respectively, possessing a healing factor and retractable blades like the former and is a master swordsman like the latter. Although his origins are unknown, even to himself, he was taken in as a child under the sword master Tanba Yagyu, and would later train alongside Eric Brooks before he became known as the vampire hunter "Blade". Kikyo, who was equally skilled but arrogant, was only concerned with winning, a fault which his master called him out for. After two years of Yagyu's training, Eric decided to leave to continue his training with Noah van Helsing, but Kikyo refused to let him leave without one last duel to determine which of them was the strongest. However, he suffered a quick and humiliating defeat by Eric, and while Kikyo demanded for his rival to take his head, Eric said he already lost it. After training under Yagyu for another two years, Kikyo was sent packing as Yagyu claimed he had nothing more to teach him and that Kikyo needed to see the real world. Although he was reluctant, he accepted his master's wishes and was grateful that he took him in. He wasn't aware that Yagyu had been diagnosed with a lethal form of lung cancer. Some point afterward, Kikyo had been hired as an assassin of Shingen Harada, the head of the Kuzuryu yakuza gang, who was affiliated with A.I.M.. In Tokyo, after Logan and Yukio discovered that his longtime friend Tesshin Asano had been killed and were set up in his murder, Kikyo appeared before them. Possessing the same healing factor as Logan and using a sword hidden in his right arm similar to Wolverine's claws, Kikyo quickly proved to be a devastating opponent and would have killed his newfound rival if not for Logan's own healing factor. Logan later suspected that Kikyo was Asano's killer and swore revenge, but police intervention forced them both to withdrawal. Kikyo seemed impressed that Logan lasted against him, which made him determined to see which of them was the strongest. Logan later returned to Shingen's hideout in another attempt to save Mariko, but only discovered Kikyo instead, who denied that he had any involvement in Asano's death. The two fought throughout Tokyo once more, only to be interrupted by Omega Red, who Logan had already fought earlier. Kikyo stood back and allowed the two to fight, but upon the Russian's defeat, he decided to depart from the scene, telling Logan there was no honor in fighting an exhausted opponent and would fight him again when he was well and rested. Kikyo later followed Logan to Madripoor, confronting him once again just before he and Yukio could reach Hideki Kurohagi's palace, where Mariko was being held and who she was being forced to marry. Realizing what Logan was really after, Kikyo deducted that it would be an honorless fight if Logan's mind was on his goal and not the battle, and decided to put their fight on hold, even after Kurohagi ordered him to kill Logan anyway. Kurohagi then had a revitalized Vadhaka take over and fight Logan, Yukio, and Koh's resistance movement. When Min put herself in harm's way and was nearly gunned down by Shingen's men, Kikyo sliced their guns to pieces, declaring that only cowards use guns and are worse if they're used against children. He later aided Logan when Min was fatally struck by the animated statue, revealing another sword hidden in his left arm that he fought the beast with. thumb|left|260px|Kikyo about to attack Following Vadhaka's defeat and angered by Min's death, Kikyo joined Logan and Yukio in their fight against Shingen's forces, stating that he has business with them as well, but reminded Logan of their impending duel after he was done saving Mariko. When Logan confronted Shingen, who derided Kikyo for not killing him, Kikyo reminded his client that he'd only fight Logan on equal terms. Shingen terminated his contract, stating he'd gladly finish the job himself. When Logan and Shingen duel for the last time, Kurohagi attempted to shoot his distracted enemy with his special poison weapon again. Kikyo however took the hit and attempts to suck the poison out before it can kill him, refusing to let Kurohagi interfere. He watched Logan and Shingen duel alongside a mortally wounded Yukio, who finally got her chance to avenge her parents. After Shingen is killed and Yukio succumbed to her injuries, he helped Logan reach the catacombs where Kurohagi was hiding with Mariko. Kikyo held the closing door, allowing Logan to get through, ending his participation in the fight. After the battle, he and Logan faced off again in an empty field at night, fighting to determine which of them is the strongest. Logan would remain in Madripoor to investigate AIM's activities. He later came across Blade and his partner, the vampire hunter Makoto, who were investigating their involvement with Deacon Frost and Existence. kilgore slaughter.name: Kilgore Slaughter
kilgore slaughter.origin: The man known only as Kilgore Slaughter (presumably not his real name) was a potholer who was exploring caves in the Scottish Highlands when the arrival of a craft containing a Time Traveler from the future caused a 'reality wave' which transformed him into something more than human. The now fiercely glowing Slaughter, who had acquired apparently limitless powers, subsequently used his abilities to save the Time Traveler and his companion, McMurdo from killer robots from the former's home time period. Learning from the wizard Merlyn that his powers had been bestowed on him so that he could achieve a great destiny, Slaughter traveled into the future and apparently destroyed the Time Traveler's entire corrupt civilization inside thirty minutes before returning to the present day and his new companions. His subsequent whereabouts and activities are unknown.

killdozer.name: Killdozer
killdozer.origin: The man who became Killdozer and his two partners worked at Stane International at the time when Obadiah Stane acquired Stark International. As engineers, they had the opportunity to study and reverse-engineer some of the tech from the Iron Man Armor, and worked even more freely after Stane's death. Creating their own armor, the trio went independent as the Iron Trinity. While trying to steal a sonic bomb from Stane Int'l, Killdozer, Heavy Metal Jacket and Steel-Fist were confronted by the Falcon. During the fight, the bomb went off and damaged their armor, forcing the Trinity to flee.

killer jungle creature.name: Killer (Jungle Creature)
killer jungle creature.origin: The beast known as the Killer was a half-crocodile, half-ape creature of unknown origins. It stalked the jungles of the Congo jungle during the 1950s. In 1954, the Congolese government hired explorer Greg Knight to hunt and kill the creature. However, Greg never had the opportunity as the creature crossed paths with his frequent companion Lorna the Jungle Girl who made it her mission to stop the Killer herself. When the creature attacked a nearby village, Lorna attacked it and tricked it into chasing her into the jungle, there she lured the giant beast to the edge of a cliff. She knocked the creature over the edge, causing it to fall to its death.
weaknesses: The Killer could be easily outwitted. It also wasn't durable enough to survive a long fall off a cliff.

killer beasts.name: Killer Beasts
killer beasts.origin: The so called "Killer Beasts" were scientific abominations created by the Nazis during World War II. They were attack dogs specially bred and biologically engineered to have poison glands in their mouths, making their bites lethal. Their creation was commissioned by Oberst von Steibel to be used in the first phase of an invasion of the United States. A number of these dogs were smuggled into the US and used in an attack on Camp Lehigh that saw the death of several soldiers during tank maneuver practice. One of these dogs was killed by Captain America who tossed his shield at the creature while protecting his young sidekick Bucky from attack. The rest of the dogs were slain when Captain America blew up the truck transporting them with a Nazi grenade. If anymore of these dogs existed or were used again is unrecorded. If such was the case, they were likely destroyed before the war's end.
powers: These dogs were bred with poison glands in their mouth making their bites lethal. A single bite from these dogs had enough poison to kill a man in a few moments.

killer brogan.name: Killer Brogan
killer brogan.origin: thumb|left|"Killer" Brogan Killer Brogan was a mobster that was active in the Red Valley area of the United States during the 1940's. By 1942, he learned that long time resident "Old Man" John Lester had a mine on his property that led directly under Red Valley. Taking Lester hostage in his own home, Borgan created a lifelike mask and posed as Lester and hid out on the property with his gang while he planned his heist. To this end, Borgan as "Lester" drove away those who came to visit. This proved to be his undoing when Mark Todd (secretly the Blazing Skull), a long time family friend of Lester, came for a visit. When Brogan chased the hero away with gunfire, he decided to investigate as the Blazing Skull. That night, Brogan (disguised as Lester) used the mine shaft to rob the local bank. He killed the security guard on staff that night, making sure that he was seen as Lester. Rushing back to Lester's home, Brogan was confronted by the Blazing Skull. Brogan and his gang knocked the hero and locked him in the same room as the real Lester. Planning to leave Lester to take the rap for his crime, Brogan then went to eliminate the Blazing Skull, who turned the tables and beat the gang into submission. As the authorities arrived to arrest the gang, Brogan escaped into the mine. Fighting the Blazing Skull within the shaft, Brogan caused a cave-in that crushed him to death with tons of rock.

killer casey.name: Killer Casey
killer casey.origin: Killer Casey was a heavyweight boxer who was active in the 1940s. He was the heavyweight champ partially due to his manager using crooked means to insure that Killer won his matches. When hopeful contender Danny Dougherty went into the ring, he was knocked out and left paralyzed with a fractured skull. His neighbor, policewoman Betty Dean suspected foul play and asked her ally Namor to investigate. Namor challenged Killer Casey to a match at Madison Square Gardens. Noting Namor's superior strength, Casey's manager came with a way to stack the odds in Casey's favor. During the match, they attempted to weaken Namor with a heat ray and later splashed ammonia in his eyes. Their efforts only managed to anger Namor to the point where he knocked Killer Casey right out of the ring with his most powerful punch. Namor won the match. Namor gave the prize money to the Dougherty family to help with their medical expenses. Casey's activities over the next several years is unknown, but by 1948 he had obtained a new manager, Hawk Martin, and was again a famed (and feared) boxing champ. However, while in the midst at causing a ruckus in a restaurant, Casey was floored by a lucky punch from would-be opera star Scott Warren, an accident which enraged both him and Hawk due the possible bad press. Seeing Scotti -- having let the incident go to his head -- abandon his singing career to become a boxer himself, Casey and Hawk set up a series of fixed fights for the supposed next champion to win, planning to easily thrash Scotti during the big match between them, thus earning a small fortune from bets made on the fight while getting even with the former singer. Luckily, the original accident had been witnessed by "Steve Rogers" and Betsy Ross, who investigated as Captain America and Golden Girl, easily learning the truth. When facing Scotti with the evidence failed to work, Cap then chose to foil Casey and Hawk's plans by acting as Scotti's training partner, injured him prior to the night of the big fight, and then took over as Scotti's substitute, beating the brutal champ in spite of his and Hawk's tricks. Having learned the error of his ways, Scotti humbly accepted a portion of the won purse to again pursue a musical career, while Killer Casey was again left an apparent has-been. Killer Casey's boxing career after this defeat remains unrevealed.
abilities: Killer Casey is a capable heavyweight .
weaknesses: Casey relies too heavily on his strength, bruiser mentality, and intervention from his manager to win matches. He does not appear to have any real strategy in the ring.

killer dawson.name: Killer Dawson
killer dawson.origin: Killer Dawson was a ruthless criminal who was active in the 1940s. He was locked in prison for murder but escaped in the winter of 1943. He was soon captured by Detective Carey. Carey's car broke down on a country road as he was attempting to bring the crook in. Happening on the scene was rich socialite Marla Drake who was heading to a costume party in a leopard print costume. When Carey attempted to take her vehicle with his gun drawn, she mistook him Killer Dawson and knocked the officer out. She soon learned her mistake when checking Carey's identifications and then being thanked by the real Killer Dawson, who thought that she was trying to spring him from police custody. Marla played along until Dawson attempted to get away in her car with her as passenger. Marla slammed on the breaks, causing Dawson to strike his head on the steering wheel, knocking him out. Dawson was then cuffed to Carey's unconscious body and Marla went to get a doctor for both men. Dawson was soon back in police custody and the situation had the press referring to Marla as the "Black Fury", and it being the first of her many costumed adventures. Killer Dawson's subsequent fate is unrevealed.

killer king cole.name: Killer King Cole
killer king cole.origin: Killer King Cole committed a bank robbery in a seemingly peaceful town. He easily escaped, as the locals were afraid of him. A young boy called Mickey admired Cole, and performed a copycat robbery while masked like his idol. Two-Gun Kid arrested the boy, but Cole revealed himself to be the boy's mentor. Cole came in defense of his student and pulled a gun on the Kid. The Kid was faster than Cole and disarmed the experienced robber. Mickey turned the tables on the Kid, anf managed to disarmed the gunslinger. Cole then used a rock to beat the Kid. Cole subsequently ordered Mickey to kill the Kid. The Kid recovered and managed to disarm Mickey. With his remaining pistol, the Kid shot Cole's pistol out of the man's hand. Without their weapons, Cole and the Kid faced each other in a fist fight. Cole pulled out a dagger and wounded Kid in the arm. However, the Kid still managed to outfight Cole and to capture his opponent. He delivered Cole to the local jail. While in captivity, Cole had a nervous breakdown.
abilities: Experienced gunfighter and skilled in unarmed combat. He also uses throwing daggers as back-up weapons.
weaknesses: Slower on the draw, and less skilled than Two-Gun Kid

killer kole.name: Killer Kole
killer kole.origin: Killer Kole was a killer who was executed on the electric chair during the 1940s for his crimes. Before his death, he vowed that he would kill the three judges responsible for sentencing him to death. Through a quirk of fate, this seemingly empty threat would become a reality. In the summer of 1942, Dr. Thomas Austin has announced that he had perfected a way to bring the dead back to life and intended to show the press and his students by bringing a deceased gorilla back to life. His colleague Dr. Jason Weirdler, having grown jealous of Austin's success, had the gorilla's brain replaced with that of Killer Kole, hoping to embarrass Austin should his experiment succeed. Among those witnessing the experiment were Captain America and Bucky; however, it was a failure. Humiliated, Dr. Austin gave up on his attempts. His students buried the gorilla and in some sick jest dressed it up in human clothing. That night, there was a powerful storm, and as fate would have it, a bolt of lightning struck the creature's grave, creating the catalyst needed to revive Kole's brain in the gorilla's body. Alive once again, and apparently unshaken by his new grotesque form, Kole sought to get revenge against the judges that sentenced him to death. Seeking to gather his old gang together, some reflex memory in his new body brought him instead to the Wengler Brothers Circus where the ape originated from. There, Killer Kole freed the other apes and they willingly followed him into the night, Kole seemingly having full control over them or having their full obedience. Fleeing into Central Park, Kole clashed with Captain America, who was confused when the talking ape called himself Killer Kole. Escaping Captain America and Bucky, Kole paid a visit to the home of Judge Hudson, one of the judges who sentenced him to death. Kole attempts to strangled him to death in his sleep before Captain America and the authorities could arrive. Likewise, when Kole went to kill Judge Basset, they stopped him in the act. Also by this time, Dr. Weirdler had heard the news, and horrified by the menace he unleashed, vowed to help correct his grave mistake. Having cornered Killer Kole at the home of Judge Johnson, Captain America and Bucky prevented Kole from hanging the judge. During the altercation, Kole attempted to throw a knife at Captain America; however Dr. Weirdler stepped into its path, sacrificing his life to save Captain America. With the fire department raising ladders into Johnson's apartment to allow the police to enter, Killer Kole pounced out the window and attempted to use the ladder to escape. Captain America jumped after him and knocked the villain off the ladder, sending him toppling to his death.

killer shrike hobgoblin.species: Human who bought the rights to use the name Killer Shrike
killer shrike hobgoblin.origin: ===Becoming Killer Shrike=== After Simon Maddicks sold the original Killer Shrike suit to the Hobgoblin, he sold the suit to an unnamed criminal. ===Goblin War=== Killer Shrike was present during a battle between Hobgoblin's forces and the Goblin Underground. He, along with every other Hobgoblin franchise, joined Team Goblin when Green Goblin apparently killed Hobgoblin, really Kingsley's butler Claude. Killer Shrike was among the former Hobgoblin minions that encountered Electro at the Bar with No Name. Killer Shrike was among the villains seen at the funeral for Francine Frye that was held at the Bar with No Name at the time when Black Cat arrived looking for assistance against Spider-Man. He was later among the villains that sided with Black Cat when she was forming her gang. Killer Shrike was among the villains rounded by Missile Mate and brought to Goblin King where Missile Mate claimed that Hobgoblin "abandoned" them. Black Cat later had Killer Shrike and Melter beat up Ringer. Killer Shrike later joined Swarm's Sinister Six when they attacked Spider-Man and the students of the Jean Grey School for Higher Learning. After Swarm was defeated, the villains surrendered.

killian devo.name: Killian Devo
killian devo.origin: ===Origins=== thumb|left Dr. Killian Devo was a retired S.T.R.I.K.E. operative. At some point in his life, he was found by a version of Omega Sentinel from an alternate future where mutantkind had prevailed, becoming the dominant lifeforms on Earth and destroying both human and machine resistance. The Omega Sentinel blinded Devo, replacing his eyes with cybernetic implants. Through this action, she rewrote his memories, sharing her own life experiences with him. Believing himself to have come from her dystopic world, Devo established Orchis, an anti-mutant organization aimed at preventing the possible dire future through the extermination of mutantkind. ===Orchis=== Following the establishment of the mutant-exclusive society of Krakoa, the Orchis Protocols were enacted and Orchis was made operational, staffed by agents from groups like S.T.R.I.K.E., A.I.M., S.H.I.E.L.D., S.W.O.R.D., Alpha Flight, A.R.M.O.R., and even H.A.M.M.E.R. and Hydra. Based in the space-station baptized as the Forge, Devo led Orchis as their director and leader of their Central Column. Devo remained unaware of the true purpose of Orchis. Omega Sentinel had established the organisation so that humanity and mutantkind would be busy fighting each other, while she enacted her plan of attracting a Dominion, which would absorb her and the other Sentinels into its infinite self. After Dr. Alia Gregor succeeded in bringing Nimrod online, Omega Sentinel recruited him to her true cause. It would not be long before Orchis escalated their plans. Having hacked the Krakoan medicines that the nascent mutant nation had used to buy acceptance from the United Nations, Orchis launched a massive attack on the Hellfire Gala, blackmailing Professor X into telepathically forcing every mutant on Earth into portals to Arakko, threatening to use their control of the Krakoan medicines to begin killing humans for every mutant that remained. However, the mutants soon began mounting a resistance, as many key X-Men had been able to resist Xavier's command. Aided by Krakoan traitor Sebastian Shaw, Devo was kept secure, in case the mutants succeeded and Orchis needed to be re-established. However, true to his nature Shaw was playing both sides, and had planned to turn Devo over to the mutants if it appeared that they would win. Shaw's son Shinobi Shaw forced his father's hand by revealing Devo's location to the X-Men. The X-Men attacked the boat carrying Devo. He attempted to exile the team to the Negative Zone with Reed Richards' tech confiscated by Orchis. However, he was stopped by the Latverian mutants, and killed by Volta Doom.
powers: Infrared and Ultraviolet Sight: Having his eyes replaced by machine components, Devo's cybernetic implants allow him to see in the infrared and ultraviolet spectrums.

killian fox.name: Killian Fox
killian fox.origin: Killian Fox was a friend of Ashley Croix, the former love interest of the hero Nightwatch. She was house-sitting for Ashley while she and her son were away on a company project in San Francisco. She later has a chance encounter when a down-on-his-luck Dr. Kevin Trench was trying to get into the Columbus Community Center on the Upper West Side. Killian took pity on Kevin and suggested they went and at least tried to find him a jacket. She also revealed that she worked at the community center and was looking for her missing father.

killian frakes.name: Killian Frakes
killian frakes.origin: Killian Frakes was a Deputy Commissioner of the New York City Police Department involved in internal decisions concerning public information related to the Punisher and later served as a departmental spokesperson following a major incident in New York City. During an internal investigation into Detective Bolt’s testimony regarding the Punisher’s involvement in several incidents, the Deputy Commissioner of Public Information authorized the deletion of a recorded interrogation after determining that Bolt’s public reputation as a hero could benefit the police department, despite conflicting witness accounts. Following violent events connected to Frank Castle on Wall Street, Deputy Commissioner Killian Frakes addressed the press at One Police Plaza. Speaking about the NYPD’s longstanding handling of the Punisher, Frakes stated that the department had previously made compromises regarding Castle’s activities and declared that the situation had changed after Castle shot police officers, describing it as a moment in which “the rules have changed.”

killspree.name: Killspree
killspree.origin: ===Origin=== Killspree's history is unknown and remains a mystery even after joining Department K, headed by General Clarke, and its covert super-human group known as Weapon P.R.I.M.E.. It is unknown whether he had joined the team after Grizzly left as his replacement or by happenstance. ===Compromising Positions=== Under the code-name Killjoy he would first see action when Domino and ex-teammate Grizzly, posing as Val Cooper and General Clarke, broke into the Department K Complex to steal classified files on Cable. thumb|left|130px Being sent to stop the infiltrators Tigerstryke, the teams new leader, did not hesitate when seeing Grizzly and orders the team to attack. As the others kept the infiltrators buys, and as Grizzly tried to explain to Domino who Weapon P.R.I.M.E. was. Though he had no idea who Killjoy was, and only described him as quiet smiling guy. Killjoy slipped away unseen, and coming out of the shadows behind Domino he introduced himself as he nearly decapitating her. But thanks to Hammer, who had been monitoring the situation as he secretly downloading the files, warn her just in time to dodge his attack. As he turn his attention to Grizzly, hurt him with a slash to the stomach, Domino had him keep Killjoy busy while she blasted him in the face with a magnesium flare. When Grizzly blasted a hole into the sewer runoff access duct above them, under Tigerstryke orders Double Trouble tried to stop them. But Grizzly and Domino managed to make it into the sewers, and outside of the complex as Hammer waited for them in his RV. Yeti and Killjoy seemed to hang back as Double Trouble and Tigerstryke gave chase. But they when Hammer activated the RV's jet mod, allowing them to get away. ===The Quick and the Dead=== When Alpha Flight was suspended, General Clarke wanted Weapon P.R.I.M.E. to take their place as Canada's preeminent superhero team. But when Alpha Flight member Northstar refused to stop his activities Killjoy, now code-named Killspree, and the team were sent to capture and remove Northstar from the public eye under Military Ordinance B-6345. Heading to Northstar's villa, of the coast of Ibiza, Spain; a car was spotted, and believing it was Northstar. Tigerstryke and Killspree, hung back as Yeti and Double Trouble are sent ahead to deal with the car. Yeti and Double Trouble went to deal with the car, and once it was off road he moved in. Slicing the door off, Tigerstryke had him stand down as he moved in to arrest Northstar. But unfortunately they found that they had attacked and badly injured the wrong guy. After ransacking Northstar's villa, and finding he had just given them the slip, Tigerstryke used his suits tracking tech and took off after him. thumb|260px Finding Northstar five miles due east of his home, Tigerstryke gave him the choice to come in the easy way or the hard way. But Northstar, allowing his anger over Arcade putting his friend Mariel in danger to get to him, chose the hard way. Attacking Tigerstryke first, he was mostly able to avoid Yeti and when he took a moment to mock Yeti, Killspree attacked him from behind. Mocking Northstar back as he nearly matched his incredible speed, and even managing to slice him with his forearm blade. But Northstar got a hold of him, and threw Killspree into an awaiting Double Trouble's connecting plasma charge that caused an explosion. That is when Tigerstryke quickly took Northstar down with a blast from behind, while down he and Yeti ran in to apprehend him. But Northstar, seeing them coming, and realizing he needed to stop fighting and help his friend, quickly flew up at the last possible moment. Causing Yeti and Tigerstryke to smash head first into each other, and while stunned Northstar made his escape. Tracking Northstar to Zuyeyo, Russia; Killspree and team were shocked that he was now willing to let them arrest him. Unaware Northstar only surrendered because, for the moment, he thought they were with Arcade. However, as Yeti felt Tigerstryke should just shoot him. Killspree voiced his suspicion of it being a trick, when he was suddenly hit from behind and knocked down by a thrown crowbar. As Tigerstryke was trying to see what happened, Yeti warned them of who was coming as they were attacked by a group of circus performers. Believing this was Northstar's plan all along, Tigerstryke went to blast the attackers. But Northstar stopped him, and revealed they were civilians being mind-controlled by one of Arcade's devices. So Killspree and the others, while waiting for his orders, did their best not to seriously harm the swarming civilians. With Killspree pushing, and cutting to pieces the civilian's weapons with his forearms blades. But because there was no allowance for this eventuality or contingency plan, Tigerstryke wasn't sure what to do. Northstar suggested he tell Killspree and the rest of the team to take evasive actions as he flew Tigerstryke high above them. Doing as Northstar asked, Tigerstryke scanned for Arcade's device
abilities: Hand-to-Hand Combat: Killspree is a skilled fighter. Multilingualism: Killspree speaks basic Russian.
weapons: Killspree's outfit was equipped with various blades.

kilmer.name: Kilmer
kilmer.origin: Kilmer was a member of the Warclan, one of the different communities of the Neo, who comprised different clans of recluse mutants. The Neo suffered a major crisis after the High Evolutionary temporarily deactivated the mutant gene. As a result, they unleashed their rage upon Earth and, more specifically, the X-Men, a group of mutant activists who promoted racial integration. The Warclan brutally attacked the X-Men. Kilmer was part of the squadron tasked with hunting Nightcrawler down. At some point, the surviving Neo were claimed to have been wiped out by Evolutionaries. Although their fate is uncertain, their survival seems unlikely.
powers: Kilmer is a Mutant of the Neo, and displayed the following abilities: Peak human strength Peak human speed Peak human endurance Peak human reflexes. His other powers were never revealed.

kim hong.name: Kim Hong
kim hong.origin: Kim Hong was a television news personality in New York City, recruited by Moon Knight as "Scout" to be part of his Shadow Cabinet agents and informants. How he earned her allegiance is unknown, and Scout was initially unaware of her boss's identity. Kim Hong was at Brinkstone Prison covering the execution of religious serial killer John DeZoan when Moon Knight infiltrated the prison to confront Demogoblin. A power outage caused by Moon Knight's entry interrupted DeZoan's electrocution, giving him super-powers instead. As Deadzone, DeZoan killed most of the people in the viewing box, including Kim's cameraman. She encountered Moon Knight while trying to get to safety, and learned his role in the Shadow Cabinet for the first time when he called her "Scout". When he feared he was dying, Moon Knight activated the Legacy protocols to find a potential replacement. Scout helped him test one of his possible subjects, Peter Parker.

kim larsen.name: Kim Larsen
kim larsen.origin: Kim Larsen was first officer, first of the Bengal Queen and then of the Eastern Moon. He was the most hated character by the sailors who had to obey his orders. He would beat to death those who he thought were lazy, and then declare that they were dead because they were weak, and he also declared to everyone that he would never die at sea. During his last voyage on the Eastern Moon, he met the Devil who advised him to abandon the ship because it would be wrecked and sunk, confirming to him that it was true that he would never die at sea as thanks for having involuntarily served him. Remaining arrogant even with the Devil telling him that he wasn't afraid of him either, the Devil told him that even if it were true that he would never die there were things worse than death and with the destruction of the ship he ended up at sea to remain a drifts forever without ever finding peace or rest.

kim lewis.name: Kim Lewis
kim lewis.origin: thumb|left|200px|Kim Lewis Kim Lewis was a circus stunt rider who was active during the days of the American Frontier. Suffering injuries while on tour, Kim went to her uncle's cabin to recuperate. Growing bored she developed the identity of the Black Rider to have some fun by holding up coaches, but not robbing them, choosing to commit crimes for the thrill. Her activities as the Black Rider attracted the attention of the Two-Gun Kid who attempted to stop her and was delivered a humiliated defeat instead. Seeing fun in this, she then left a note for her uncle claiming that the Black Rider "kidnapped" her so that the Two-Gun Kid would continue to pursue her. Sure enough, the heroic gunslinger did and was always a step behind the Black Rider. When Two-Gun eventually captured her, he was shocked to find that the Black Rider and Kim were the same person. Furious with her horseplay, Two-Gun gave her a spanking and was determined to tell her uncle. However, after seeing the pair happily reunited and getting a kiss on the cheek from Kim, Two-Gun could not bring himself to tell her uncle the truth and left. thumb|right|200px|Kim gets what she deserved. Kim's subsequent activities are unknown.

kim rhee.name: Kim Rhee
kim rhee.origin: Kim Rhee was an ex-Korean army officer, who led a well-armed gang of Armani-wearing gangsters in the West 80s of New York City. They were involved in the protection rackets and were expanding into policy, stolen goods, and both cigarette & liquor smuggling (all activities in which their Irish rivals the Black Cullens were involved). He was also trying to take over the blocks east of Columbus, increasing tensions with the Black Cullens. Kim invited the leader of the Black Cullens to a sit down, but in reality was planning an ambush. Unfortunately for him, a black kid fired a gun at a group of black teenagers (who had stolen his Jordan shoes), alerting the Black Cullens and setting off a firefight. The Punisher who had been following the Black Cullens, got involved turning it into a 3-way shootout. The end result being all of the mobsters ending up dead.

kimberly potters.name: Kimberly Potters
kimberly potters.origin: Kimberly Potters was a mutant in the year 2099, when an invitation to Xi'an's gathering gave her the opportunity to join his newest incarnation of the X-Men. While at the gathering, Serpentina, nicknamed Tina, met with a scared and confused Timothy Fitzgerald. She greeted him and tried to put him at ease, showing him her powers, and introducing him to the entertainment of the day, the mutant Metalhead. She told him that Xi'an had called them there and told him that he would change his life, but when an assassin fired at Xi'an, and Tim fired a bolt of siphoned energy back at him, ruining his aim, Tina fled along with the other X-Men from the Synge Corporation, who believed that Xi'an had killed their former head, Noah Synge. While a group of the other X-Men broke into the Synge Corporation building to clear Xi'an's name, Serpentina was left behind with Cerebra and Timothy when Junkpile attacked them and stole Xi'an's body, which had cocooned itself to protect itself from injury. Tina jumped on Junkpile, but was thrown towards a chasm, only surviving by grabbing the ledge at the last moment. When the first group was captured, Tina and the remaining X-Men made their way into the Synge Corporation building, themselves. They found Meanstreak and Metalhead floating in stasis gel, but Tina smashed open the containers rather than see her friends imprisoned, and freed them. Together they fought through the building's security forces, towards the office of Lytton Synge, where they ran into Junkpile. Before the rest of the team could form a strategy, Tina leapt forward and attacked him, but he quickly reacted and crushed her face into a concrete wall, killing her. When Xi'an rose from his cocoon, he tried to heal Tina with his newly evolved powers, but he found that he could do nothing for the dead. The X-Men buried Tina in a crystal coffin created by her fellow member, Krystalin. Yet, because she believed so fiercely in Xi'an's vision, her death galvanized Timothy into permanently joining the X-Men. Later, to use her against the X-Men, the Graverobber revived Tina's body and used her as a mindless puppet against Xi'an's team. When one of the other members of the Undead team lured Timothy, now called Skullfire, into an alley, Tina shot and killed him with a poisoned dart, so that Graverobber could revive him to use his powers. When Morphine Somers tricked the Graverobber by planting a bomb on the hostage he demanded, and destroyed him, Tina was freed from his spell and fell dead once again. The X-Men then cremated her and spread her ashes to the wind so that she could never be revived again.
powers: Serpentina is able to extend her arms, legs, and torso. She could use this power to wrap around opponents and bind them.

kimberly vesco.name: Kimberly Vesco
kimberly vesco.origin: Kimberly Vesco had been born in Salem but had been orphaned as an infant and adopted by a couple in Chicago, where she was raised until her teenage years with no knowledge history of her past or where she was from originally. Salem was a town split between magic-using families referred to as "Wicks" and those without magical abilities, called "Blanks". After a "wick" with precognitive powers, Francis Foley started predicting an unspecified disaster coming to Salem, Foley used a spell to summon Vesco, believing her to be the "fulcrum", a kind of magical savior. Vesco's family moved to Salem, unknowingly under the influence of Foley's spell, where she had trouble fitting in at first. Many of her classmates, and Vesco herself, believed Vesco to be a clueless "blank" and were skeptical that she was the savior Foley believed her to be. After discovering her own magical necromancy powers and barely escaping multiple attacks from a mysterious Thief, Vesco was taken under the guidance of Foley, his friends LB Harrington and Mink, their rival coven Mason Kaleema, Paul Aristides, and Ren Lowell, as well as the ghosts of David Knox and Sally Sherman, two of the Thief's former victims. The group took Vesco to the Pillar of Smoke, a magical artifact and source of the Salem "wicks" powers, where they were attacked by the Thief, revealed to be their classmate Chad Barrow, a magical mutant with the power to steal and control other's magics. Barrow left the group for dead and used the power of the Pillar to take control of all the wicks in Salem, intending to steal all their magic and use it to resurrect Sally Sherman, who had been Barrow's ex-girlfriend and first victim. Vesco and her allies had survived and returned as a group to oppose Barrow. Vesco used her necromancy powers to free the resurrected Sherman from Barrow's control. Uninterested in returning to life at the mercy of the man who murdered her, Sherman magically attached herself to Barrow and dragged him with her into the Realm of the Dead. As the group left the scene, triumphant, Foley mentioned that he was predicting "something worse" coming, to which Vesco expressed confidence that they'll be ready. Vesco was listed as "Status undetermined" by Tony Stark in his post-Civil War case files.
powers: She has power over the dead, can see and hear ghosts and can create and close pathways to the Realm of the Dead. : She can cause her spirit to leave its body and then re-enter it at will

kimeiko ashu.name: Kimeiko Ashu
kimeiko ashu.origin: Kimeiko was a member of the South Vietnamese Street Gang the Poison Memories. He slept with Namorita after meeting her in a club after a night of drinking. The next morning, Ashu stole her address book, which contained the names of her fellow New Warriors members' names and home addresses. With the address book, he and his crew kidnapped Nova's brother Robert Rider and Speedball's father Justin Baldwin. 2 units of the gang defied Ashu's orders and murdered Rage's grandmother Edna Staples and shot Firestar's father Bart Jones. In exchange for not killing Justin Baldwin and Robert Rider, many of the New Warriors turned themselves into the Poison Memories. It was revealed that Ashu had once offered to spare the lives of Silhouette's fellow gang members in the Concrete Dragons if Silhouette agreed to become his fourteen year old sex slave. Silhouette had rejected the offer, which presumably cost her the lives of some of her friends. Night Thrasher was alerted to the New Warriors' decision to hand themselves over to the Poison Memories by Hindsight Lad who went to the same high school as Speedball and had been blackmailing him into membership into the New Warriors. Hindsight Lad alerted Night Thrasher who went to rescue his former team. Kimeiko had arranged the kidnappings to get back at Night Thrasher for crushing the Poison Memories gang by revealing their leader Gai No Don was a North Vietnamese general who butchered the South Vietnamese. Ashu had hoped to shatter Night Thrasher's illusion of family (the New Warriors) the way his own family (the Poison Memories) had been shattered. Kimeko was confronted by Night Thrasher who at this point had saved the New Warriors and Ashu's hostages. Ashu attacked the group in a suit of armor created by A.I.M. The suit overheated, and the New Warriors were incapacitated by the blast. Before Ashu could use a piece of shrapnel to kill Night Thrasher, Rage fell through the ceiling window and attacked Ashu, demanding revenge for the murder of his grandmother. Night Thrasher begged the 14 year old Rage not to kill Ashu, but Rage refused and snapped Ashu's neck. Later, at a hearing, Night Thrasher as Dwayne Taylor lied to protect Rage, and Rage was found not at fault and released into Dwayne Taylor and Andrew Chord's custody.

kimura yakuza.name: Kimura (Yakuza)
kimura yakuza.origin: Kimura was the Oyabun of a Yakuza clan that operated within Madripoor from the Sovereign Hotel. He once bought the head of the android Elsie-Dee from Donald Pierce, which he used as an accountant to cook his books. When Elsie-Dee's partner Albert came to Madripoor in search for her, the facial-recognition software at the Madripoor International Airport which was hijacked by the Yakuza misidentified him as Wolverine. Since Wolverine had once killed Kimura's Aniki, Dai Kumo, Kimura sent his special enforcers after Albert for revenge, but they failed to kill him. Albert later attacked Kimura's base to retrieve Elsie-Dee's head after learning from Pierce that it was in the Yakuza's possession. After Albert killed many of his men, Kimura handed him over the head without a fight, but later gathrered his men to avenge the insult to their honor and intercept Albert before he could leave Madripoor. Kimura was also concerned with Elsie-Dee escaping with all his accounting info in her memory banks. During the confrontation with the androids, Albert rammed his getaway vehicle into Kimura's limo. Albert and Elsie-Dee then fended off Kimura's henchmen until Kimura told them to stand down so he could avenge the Yakuza's honor alone and so no one else got hurt. Seeing that Kimura had some honor in him, Albert and Elsie-Dee ceased their attack, and Elsie-Dee erased all of Kimura's bookkeeping info in her memory banks as a peace offering. Kimura then helped the androids escape Madripoor by hiding them in a shipping crate and sending them to Macao in exchange for Albert giving up one of his fingers as penance for his actions against the Yakuza.

king horse.name: King (Horse)
king horse.origin: The horse that was later known as King lived during the days of the American Frontier, alone in a valley near the town of Jackspur. When Randy Clayton's horse Smokey was spooked by a mountain lion and was no longer good to ride, his guardian the Rawhide Kid took the boy to Jackspur to find a new horse. Finding none worth buying they were told by a man about a white stallion in the nearby mountains. The Rawhide Kid and Randy then succeeded in capturing and taming the horse with the help of Apache the Rawhide Kid's own horse. Once the stallion was tamed, Randy decided to name it King after the valley that he seemingly ruled as a king. The horse took the Kid to such places before the horse brought him to Shotgun City where the hero lived for the remainder of his career. King was highly intelligent able to understand even complex instructions. This made the horse sought after by thieves such as Barlow who briefly stole the horse before it was rescued by the Rawhide Kid and Randy. Much later when Rawhide and Randy were helping a Pony Express rider who narrowly avoided being robbed, King sensed the thieves -- the Sloan gang -- not far away and attacked them. Unaware that Sloan and his gang were responsible for the attempted theft, the Kid did not know why King was attacking them. Sloan attempted to use this to his advantage by filing a complaint to Shotgun City's Sheriff Ben Yarby. After a warning from the lawman, Sloan and his men set King loose and committed a series of horse thefts wherever King was spotted making everyone in town think that King had gone rogue, including the Rawhide Kid who failed to capture the horse. While the Sheriff and others were busy searching for King, Sloan and his gang tried to rob the Shotgun City bank, but were stopped by King himself, as witnessed by the Rawhide Kid who took them into custody and had King exonerated. King later came to the aid of his master when Randy was captured by Crack, an outlaw who had a striking resemblance to the Rawhide Kid. Upon Randy's orders, King rode into town and got the real Rawhide Kid who rescued Randy from his lookalike.

king robert.name: King (Robert)
king robert.origin: King was a mutant mercenary in the service of the Kingpin, working in a crew with other two employees known as Knight and Rook. When their boss was doing business with Klaw, Knight and the rest of the team intercepted an assassination attempt on Klaw by Erik Killmonger. They captured him and brought him to the Kingpin, who ordered to have him killed. King saw potential in Erik and recruited him into the crew, occasionally suggesting him to let go of his vengeful nature. Following the successful execution of a multi-target assassination, the Kingpin decided to dispose of them by pitting them against his best mercenary, Bullseye, claiming it was a test of worth. After Bullseye ambushed the four and killed Rook, the rest escaped and King parted ways from Erik and Knight. King retreated to Sofia, Bulgaria where he lived in a cabin with his wife Celia. They were approached by Knight and Erik after Knight had arranged with S.H.I.E.L.D. to facilitate King's capture. Erik wanted simply to warn King about it so he could escape. When freelance agents contacted by Knight arrived, a shoot-out resulted in Celia's death. King was fatally injured and, in his final moments, he gave Killmonger the key to his cabin's cellar where he stored all of his weaponry so he could have revenge on Knight.

king and queen of cards.name: King and Queen of Cards
king and queen of cards.real_name: Queen Clara, King's full name unknown
king and queen of cards.origin: The King and Queen of Cards are the product of Jimmy Jupiter's imagination. They hale from the realm called Nowhere in a area known as the Kingdom of Cards. When Jimmy Jupiter fell asleep while his friends were playing cards for money, he was awoken after his playmates left and the cards came to life and began gathering themselves up to head back home. Upon learning that Jimmy did not gamble, the King and Queen had Jimmy brought to their kingdom. There they told Jimmy that whenever humans play cards for money, they force cards to go to war against each other. After imparting this lesson to Jimmy, they learned from their central intelligence that Jimmy's mother was calling for him and the royals sent Jimmy home. Their subsequent fate is unknown.

king and queen of time.name: King and Queen of Time
king and queen of time.origin: The King and Queen of Time were imaginary constructs created by Jimmy Jupiter in the land of Nowhere. They were the rulers of the Valley of Time, which appeared to be the personification of all time. Their kingdom was visited by Jimmy who was brought there by two sentient clocks who wished to teach Jimmy to value and make the most use of his time. He was brought before the king and queen who showed them their Time Machine -- a device that allowed anyone to see any point in history. When it was learned that Jimmy was a regular time waster, the King and Queen sentenced him to a spanking and sent him to his home. Their subsequent fate is unknown.

king arthur wrestler.species: Human mutated by experimental unstable anabolic steroids.
king arthur wrestler.origin: King Arthur was a professional wrestelr who won five championships five years straight but his career was ended when an injury robbed him of the use of his legs. He became a trainer for other wrestlers but secretly he also started administering them and himself experimental unstable anabolic steroids to enhance their performances, when one of his trainees, Jumpin' Jack Flash, discovered his criminal activities he took the identity of Mr. X and killed him on the ring, framing Mr. X in the process. His activities were eventually discovered by Captain America who defeated him and had him arrested, clearing Mr. X's reputation.
abilities: King Arthur was an experienced with an incredibly agile fighting style. Deception: King Arthur was a skilled liar who created a public persona completely different from his real personality.

king bolo.name: King Bolo
king bolo.origin: In the 1940s, King Bolo was the ruler of the Birdmen of the planet Sunev. When explorers Zephyr Jones and Corky Grogan arrived from Earth, it fulfilled the legends that the closely related planets would interact with each other. Zephyr and his comrade were welcomed with open arms by King Bolo, and they exchanged information and technology. However, the jealous General Roudo, a spy for the evil Parrotmen, framed Zephyr and Corky as spying on the Birdmen. With no evidence to the contrary, King Bolo sentenced Zephyr and Corky to be executed the following day. However, the Parrotmen attacked before their sentence could be carried out, and the two proved their innocence by fighting back the Birdmen with their guns and exposing Roudo as the traitor. In the battle's aftermath, Bolo had Roudo executed and thanked the Earthmen for their help. When Zephyr and Corky prepared to leave Sunev, Bolo invited them to return and suggest regular visits to his world. If this invitation has been extended remains unrevealed.

king borna.name: King Borna
king borna.origin: ===King of Valusia=== King Borna was the monarch of Valusia, and allegedly a tyrant. Conspiring against Borna were four-members group made of Baron Kaanuub of Blaal (meant to become king in Borna's stead), Count Ducalon of Komahar, the soldier Eranos, and the poet Ridondo. Ridondo lied to Kull, the commander of the Black Legion, telling him Borna was about to disband the Legion. Kull consequently rushed to the palace, challenged and slew Borna in combat and took the crown from him, to the conspirators' surprise. His body was buried at the Royal Crypts, on the outskirts of the City of Wonders. ===Legacy=== His corpse was later animated by Sekhmet Tharn (as part of a secret plan to raise an undead army of Valusian royalty to attack Kull's Valusia), and faced Kull and Brule who were inquiring disturbances around the Crypts. Unable to defeat him using weapons, Kull toppled a column over Borna, crushing the corpse. During the rule of King Kull, Ralim declared himself the son of King Borna and the rightful heir to the Topaz Throne. To prove Ralim lied, Kull hired Fen Gur to conjure an illusion of an undead Borna who rushed at Ralim, prompting him to reveal in panic his own lies.

king brian.name: King Brian
king brian.origin: King Brian was the king of Charnina, a city-state of Brythunia. For more than fifteen years , Brian was the enemy of King Tomar, a warlord and an ambitious under-king of Hyperborea. Brian was betrayed by Malachi, commander of the Brythunian Cavalry, who was the lover of Queen Kormlada, wife to King Tomar. Malachi agreed to hold back his horsemen to assure Brian's defeat. During the battle, King Brian remained at his tent, while 20,000 Brythunians clashed with an equal number of Hyperboreans. As Conan of Cimmeria, who fought along the Brythunians, was ravaging his army, Tomar fled the battle and managed to enter Brian's tent, and the two kings slew one another. When the Brythunians returned to Charnina, the power vacuum left by King Brian's death led to the rise of Lord Pollus and Lord Ludox, who vied for power, with their respective factions opposing in the streets of the city.

king crocodile.name: King Crocodile
king crocodile.origin: King Crocodile was a massive crocodile indigenous to the jungles of Brazil. By around 1954 the outside world learned of King Crocodile's existed. Famous zoologist Dr. Carle and his daughter Sherry went on an expedition to find King Crocodile. They hired a jungle guide named Jonah, who had no intention in capturing the beast for study, but instead wanted to kill it for sport. When Carle and Jonah argued over the issue, Jonah shot Dr. Carle and left Sherry to fend for herself in the jungle. Incidentally, Shelly was the first person to locate King Crocodile and she found that the beast was actually quite friendly to human beings and she quickly befriended the beast and tried her best to keep it safe. However, Jonah continued to hunt it until he was confronted by the Sub-Mariner and his companion Betty Dean who held Jonah off long enough for King Crocodile to eat him. Discovering Sherry and learning what happened, the Sub-Mariner and Betty Dean helped Sherry arrange to have King Crocodile brought to a reptile sanctuary in Florida so that he would be safe from other hunters. King Crocodile's current status and fate is unknown.
