kuragari.name: Kuragari
kuragari.first_appearance: Psylocke and Archangel Crimson Dawn Vol 1 1
kuragari.origin: Kuragari was from the Realm of the Crimson Dawn. When he murdered Tar, he became the new Proctor of the Dawn, and sent his Undercloaks to claimed Psylocke for his bride. They attacked Archangel and Psylocke in their apartment, leaving behind an engagement ring. Gomurr came to warn them, but he was too late, and Psylocke, enchanted by the ring, slipped it on, allowing Kuragari to steal her away to his realm. Archangel followed, but by then, Psylocke had been brainwashed and transformed into Kuragari's Shadow Queen. She left him behind, going with Kuragari. Gomurr was next visited by the spirit of the deceased Tar, who named him the next rightful proctor of the Crimson Dawn. Gomurr accepted, and he joined Archangel in his fight. In order to free Betsy from the Dawn's influence, Warren sacrificed a piece of his own life force to replace what had been given, and the couple was reunited. Gomurr managed to defeat Kuragari, becoming the next proctor of the Dawn.

When the Black Demon went after Grant, both the Sub-Mariner and his friend Betty Dean were present to keep an eye on him. While Namor stopped the Black Demon's men from kidnapping Grant, the Black Demon kidnapped Betty then left a phony note from "Betty" to lead Namor into a trap. Namor expected this and was ready for the Black Demon and his men, easily defeating them. Namor then unmasked the Black Demon and freed his victims. Brown's subsequent fate is unknown.

kurt barton.name: Kurt Barton
kurt barton.origin: ===Early Adventures=== In 1945, the war brought Japanese and American forces to battle in Africa. Kurt "Breeze" Barton, flying over the Sahara desert, was shot down. Surviving the crash, he attempted to reach civilization; suffering from dehydration he passed out in front of a city he believed to be a mirage. Waking up in a room, he met Ann Barclay. Barclay informed him that he had passed through a portal into another dimension and that he was in the "City of the Mirage" (aka the Miracle City). It was a timeless realm where nobody aged, and the portal that brought them there was one way only. Barton learned about this strange new world and met with the city's chief scientist Zanoba. Barton deduced that using magnetism might reverse the polarity of the portal and allow those trapped in this dimension to return to the Earth. This information was overheard by the evil Mubahn ruler of the Demon People. They captured Zanoba, leading Breeze to lead an army to save Zanoba before Mubahn could probe his mind and learn the secrets of magnetism. In combat, Breeze slayed Mubahn and freed his slaves, ending the conflict with the Demon People. With the device created by Zanoba, Breeze, and Ann successfully returned to Earth. However, they discovered that 50 years had passed since they had gone and it was now the year 1995. Their world had been ravaged by endless warfare and most humans had devolved into primitive savages. Joining up with Jacques "Frenchy" Reliure's resistance fighters, Breeze became determined to rebuild civilization. His first task was overthrowing the leader of a local tribe of savages. Challenging the tribe's leader to one on one combat, Breeze defeated the evil chief even after the chief attempted to cheat. Afterward, when the ex-chief attempted to kill Breeze, he was saved by Ann. Setting up a new base to build the foundations of their society, Breeze and his people were attacked by raiders. Stopping them and showing them the errors of their ways, he sent them back to their leader, Sabarr. A furious Sabarr mounted a counter attack, capturing Breeze and Ann. The duo escaped and in the final battle, Breeze killed Sabarr with a grenade. With their leader dead, the thieves surrendered and agreed to join Barton's cause. Breeze and Ann were last seen going to explore the rest of the Earth, their subsequent activities are as yet unrecorded. ===Modern Age=== Much later, Breeze Barton was recruited by Earth-616's Howard the Duck to be part of his Ducky Dozen who were on a mission for ARMOR to stop a zombie plague that had spread on Earth-12591, a world where the Nazis had won World War II thanks to unleashing the infection. During the opening battle, Breeze boldly jumped out of the team's ship, using his jet pack to assist him in blasting Nazi zombies that were being launched at his teammates from cannons. When he landed, however, he was torn in half by the zombified Sub-Mariner of the Invaders.
abilities: Breeze is a trained soldier, pilot, and a capable fighter.
affiliations: Alternate Reality Monitoring and Operational Response Agency (Earth-616)/Members

kurt dagmar.name: Kurt Dagmar
kurt dagmar.origin: The Martian disguised as the human Kurt Dagmar was the head of the Stati, the East German secret police during the Cold War. After the Wall fell, he arrived to Madripoor. thumb|250px|left|True form revealed He set up as an arms dealer in the island, a business which brought him wealth. Dagmar acquired his first Deathlok by bribing a Roxxon employee, and years later made himself an army of them, from both this universe and other alternate timelines, as well as the original Deathlok Luther Manning, whom he kept under control, like the rest, but allowed him some free will so Manning could see himself being controlled by Dagmar. Dagmar also possessed other A.I. like Sentinels and Kree Sentinels in his storage hub. Herr Dagmar captured Toro, the Human Torch's former sidekick, to attract the attention of the synthetic hero and capture him. The Human Torch arrived to Dagmar's base in the Black Forest along with the Invaders, who soon found themselves attacked by Dagmar's Deathlok army, in order to give Dagmar's experts enough time to synch his machines with the Human Torch's cerebral cortex in order to subdue him. Captain America came to the Invader's rescue, and deflected a deadly ray directed at Namor towards Dagmar himself, who upon being killed by the ray, revealed his true form of a Martian.

kurt gerhardt.name: Kurt Gerhardt
kurt gerhardt.origin: ===Early Life=== Kurt Gerhardt reached a state of homicidal despair after the random murder of his father, a divorce, the loss of his bank job (part of the savings and loan crisis), and being brutally robbed at his new job in a fast-food restaurant. ===Foolkiller=== Greg Salinger, the Foolkiller, is noted by popular talk show host, Runyan Moody, who browbeats his way into an interview with Salinger. Gerhardt sees this and via Salinger's secret use of the modem in his therapist's computer, they set up a correspondence. Salinger directs Gerhardt to an old confidant who provides him with the Foolkiller costume and "purification gun". He eventually abandoned the gaudy costume, substituting a simple leather mask and vest (or appearing in a variety of disguises), and created a simpler calling card: "Foolkiller / e pluribus unum / Actions have consequences." Initially, Gerhardt directed his vigilante campaign at violent criminals, garnering some praise from the public, but his anger at abuse and neglect in general led him to kill drug-addicted negligent mothers and even their (albeit violent) children in a series of escalating massacres. His ever broader definition of "fools" who deserved death broadened to include those guilty of what Gerhardt believed to be rank hypocrisy or stupidity. At Burger Clown, Gerhardt he develops a promising romantic relationship with a fellow coworker, Linda Klein. He becomes a popular man in his neighborhood. Acting heroically, even without the gun, Gerhardt saves an acquaintance from being run down by a drunk. Gerhardt, however, must be stopped from beating on the driver. In a move celebrated by his friends at the restaurant, he gains a job at a credit agency. His work-neighbor is a crass, older man who enjoys using his power for thrills and cheap revenge. In a moment of weakness, Gerhardt even considers using his gun on this man, along with others who are guilty of only being annoying. This includes the new man in Linda Klein's life. Gerhardt was especially frustrated at the public's thoughtless pursuit of instant or momentary gratification and this became the centralizing theme of his killing spree. His ever-increasing kills become more violent, taking place in front of, and traumatizing, many innocent people. Once such incident is viewed by his love interest. He even goes after 'foolish' celebrities. His final major kill was an industrialist who was stripping Amazon rain forest land to raise cattle for beef and this turned the public hostile towards the Foolkiller. After escaping the police, his online communications with Salinger having been discovered, and failing to kill his drug-lord nemesis, Gerhardt had his face altered with the assistance of his predecessor's friend. She carefully uses acid to mark his face. He leaves New York to assume a new identity in Arizona. ===Prisoner in the Raft=== At some point, Gerhardt was captured and locked into the Raft, although the circumstances surrounding his capture have not been revealed. After Electro organizes a massive breakout who cause the formation of the New Avengers. He was seen attacking Spider-Man with many other villains, after which he escaped. He was subsequently recruited into the Hood's Gang. ===Interned in Crossmore=== More recently, he was a patient in the English prison of Crossmore, now a psychiatric hospital, and seems to have feelings for the unit administrator, Ellen Whitby, and was angered at Deadpool for him to talk to her, during the Merc with a Mouth's stay there. When this one was release from his cell to the open-space of the unit, Kurt was beat up alongside the others patients, and was disfigured. His demand of release was authorized by the Parole Board, but he was reluctant to leave, being in love with the Doctor Whitby. After having created a riot to kill Deadpool, he was released by the Warden Aimes, unbeknownst that Wade had somehow replaced him, and he was actually permanently restrained within a solitary containment unit in the highest security housing area of Crossmore. ===Psycho Therapy=== Kurt was hired by the Hood to stalk and blackmail Salinger. Unbeknownst to Kurt, this was a ruse by the Hood to lure Salinger towards him so he could employ him. Kurt met his grisly fate and was shot in the face by Salinger.

kurt hausner.name: Kurt Hausner
kurt hausner.origin: Kurt Hausner was a Nazi agent active during World War II. He was sent to the United States to eliminate various statesmen and military officials. To this end, Hausner set himself up as fortune teller Yogi Zamor. As "Zamor", he had the opportunity to read the fortunes of his various targets. He always predicted that they would die at a precise time, and in order to insure this, he had clocks rigged with poison gas delivered to their homes. Following the death of U.S. Army General Peters, the costumed hero Father Time was attracted to Hausner's activities. Arriving at Peters' home, Father Time was attacked by one of the "Yogi's" men. The minion was shot by Hausner before he could provide any information about the operation. Through his fortune telling operation, Kurt succeeded in murdering at least four other high ranking officials. However, it all soon came to an end when Father Time visited the "Yogi" in his civilian guise of Larry Scott and falsely claimed he was recently appointed ambassador to Algoslavia. Sure enough, Yogi Zamor predicted Scott's death at midnight and had a clock delivered to the hero's home. Father Time then learned the true identity of Hausner and confronted him at his fortune telling establishment. Not willing to be captured, Hauser unleashed his poison gas in the hopes of killing Father Time along with him. However, this proved to be a vein attempt as Father Time protected himself with his cape. Hausner died without eliminating the foe who exposed him for what he truly was.

kurt karlbad.name: Kurt Karlbad
kurt karlbad.origin: Doctor Karlbad was a mad scientist who was trying to exchange the brain of an Ape with that of a man. He was going to use the Rawhide Kid's brain, but the Kid escaped his laboratory when he went for supplies. Fearing that the Kid would alert the authorities, Karlbad and his Ape fled into the night. He trained the Ape to perform a number of human-like tasks so that even the Kid thought that he might have succeeded in transferring his own brain into the body of the Ape. When the Kid finally tracked the Ape back to Karlbad's hideout in a cave, he was apparently able to escape through a secret exit in the back of the cave while the Ape was captured and given to Karlbad's daughter, Virginia.

kurt mueller.name: Kurt Mueller
kurt mueller.origin: Kurt Mueller was a Nazi spy who was active during World War II. After the German government bought the alliance of the Dhaka Tribe of the Malay Archipelago, Mueller was installed as their ruler. The tribe referred to him as "Kuoli", meaning "King of the Islands" and followed his orders religiously. He was later sent to eliminate and replace as U.S. soldier Lieutenant Conroy in order to steal secret plans being transported to Singapore. Posing as Conroy, he piloted Colonel Carter and his aides Steve Rogers and James Buchanan Barnes. He pretended to crash near the Malay islands. Stealing the plans, he then had his loyal tribe capture his "comrades". Separated from Colonel Carter, Rogers and Barnes changed into Captain America and Bucky and attempted to rescue Carter only to be captured. After the heroes learned "Conroy's" true identity and his mission objectives, he then prepared to toss Carter into a sacrificial flame. Captain America and Bucky broke free and, during the fight, Mueller was knocked into the flames instead, burning him alive.

weapons: When operating in Malay, Mueller wielded a pistol and a scimitar.

kurt perino.name: Kurt Perino
kurt perino.origin: Kurt Perino was one of the U.S. Generals who sent a highly trained team after the Punisher. They managed to eventually capture him as Frank would not use lethal force against U.S. soldiers. The man the Generals used to run this operation had, unbeknownst to them, been saved by Castle in the early days of his military career and felt that he owed Castle, leading him to let Castle go and walk away just as the Generals were coming to kill him personally. As none of the Generals had any combat experience Castle killed them all with ease.

kurt schnell.name: Kurt Schnell
kurt schnell.origin: Kurt Schnell was a Nazi spy who was active during World War II. By March of 1943, he had discovered that a suit of armor that was once owned by the blood thirsty Baron Trembiew was located after it was lost in in shipping thanks to the Nazi occupation of France. The suit of armor contained a powerful explosive that was invented by the Baron's modern-day descendant and was being shipped to his brother Rene in the United States, who was unaware of the armor's contents. The armor was supposedly cursed, and during a full moon, it would bleed the blood of the Baron and become fatal to the touch. Shortly after the armor arrived at Trembiew's Louisiana home, Schnell arrived offering to purchase the armor. When Trembiew refused, Schnell and his men then attempted to take it by force. The Angel attempted to stop them, but when Schnell threatened to shoot Rene's niece, the hero backed down. When one of Schnell's men attempted to take the armor, they noticed it began to bleed and upon the thug touching it he died. However, when the statue stopped bleeding, Schnell was able to touch it and carried it out to his car. The Angel attempted to follow after them, but Karl and his men pinned him behind a tree with gun fire. As they attempted to flee in their car, Rene managed to strike their getaway car with a shotgun blast from an upstairs window of his house. The bullet pierced the armor, setting off the explosives hidden inside blowing up the car and killing Schnell and his men.

kurt wagner clone moira vii 1.name: Kurt Wagner (Clone) (Moira-VII.1)
kurt wagner clone moira vii 1.origin: ===Year 1=== At the start of the Sinister Age, Nightcrawler and Doctor Nemesis were further mutated by Margali Szardos. The two were found by Mother Righteous, who started a quest to free them from the curse, and by Mister Sinister, who locked the two up and created a clone of Nightcrawler to replace him on the Quiet Council to avoid rousing suspicion. Nightcrawler later joined the X-Men and helped in defeating the Avengers who had been corrupted by Mister Sinister and made to attack the White House. This allowed the X-Men to become Earth's mightiest heroes. ===Year 5=== During a Council meeting, Storm noticed that Nightcrawler had been replaced by the imposter, prompting Sinister to emerge, revealing that he was not in the Pit, that all the Council members were under his influence, and that Kurt Wagner had been transformed into a monster. As Storm was the last council member not under Sinister's control, the clone was presumably no longer needed after this.

kurt wagner moira vii 1.name: Kurt Wagner (Moira-VII.1)
kurt wagner moira vii 1.origin: ===Year 1=== At the start of the Sinister Age, Nightcrawler and Doctor Nemesis were further mutated by Margali Szardos. The two were found by Mother Righteous, who started a quest to free them from the curse, and by Mister Sinister, who locked the two up and created a clone of Nightcrawler to replace him on the Quiet Council. ===Year 5=== During a Council meeting, Storm noticed that Nightcrawler had been replaced by the imposter, making prompting Sinister to emerge, revealing that he was not in the Pit, that all the Council members were under his influence and that Kurt Wagner had been transformed into a monster. thumb|left|200px|Nightcrawler on Year 10. ===Year 10=== Before Year 10, Mother Righteous managed to find Margali Szardos and kill her to break Nightcrawler's curse. From this point, Kurt's DNA became usable for Sinister to create Chimeras. Specifically, Nightcrawler's genes were utilized to create the Legion of the Night, Sinister's squad of assassins. The group turned against Sinister and allied themself with Mother Righteous and started stealing useful objects and weapons; during one of these quests, they met Nightcrawler and collected his memoirs and his writings about the Spark. ===Year 100=== Doctor Nemesis and Nightcrawler were abandoned on Earth, at the Graymalkin Habitat, when it was evacuated. The two were rescued by Wagnerine and the Legion. Once Nightcrawler discovered what Mother Righteous had done with the teaching of the Spark, he became enraged and attacked her. He was promptly killed by Mother Righteous and his body was mummified by his Chimeras, who started questioning Mother Righteous' leadership.

family: Raven Darkhölme (mother, deceased) Irene Adler (stepmother, deceased) Margali Szardos (foster mother, deceased)

kurt weidner.name: Kurt Weidner
kurt weidner.origin: Kurt Weidner was a Nazi spy that was active in America during World War II. By the fall of 1942, he operated a secret operation in Washington, D.C. that transmitted defense secrets back to Germany. His operation was learned about by the FBI when he was captured. Noticing a resemblance between the spy and FCC agent Jerry Carstairs, the FBI hired Carstairs to pose as Kurt Weidner in order to learn the location of the spies. Despite the fact that Weidner's unnamed boss was ruthless and killed his own agents for even the smallest infraction, he was fooled into thinking that Carstairs was Weidner until the real Weidner broke free and warned him. What the spies were not prepared for was the fact that Carstairs was secretly the costumed hero known as the Black Avenger, who easily rounded up Weidner, his boss and his companions. His fate following the war is unknown.
weapons: Weidner is armed with a pistol.

When other members of his syndicate broke in, he said he would take full responsibility if they killed her. After his men fail to kill her, she hit him before making her escape. As the Punisher made her exit, he ordered his men to stop shooting and informed one to arrange a sit down with the head of the Skang Kee family. kuthulos.name: Kuthulos
kuthulos.origin: Kuthulos was a scholar-slave of Lady Delcardes, a noblewoman of the he City of Wonders, in Valusia circa 18,500 BC. Wishing to marry Kulra Thorr, a foreigner, Delcardes had her spies gather intel, whom Kuthulos spoke as Saremes, a cat of the Old Race Kull was said he was capable of speech and clairvoyance. Kull offered Saremes a chamber in the Royal Palace, and Kuthulos always remained near her. Thulsa Doom entered Saremes' room through a secret door, bound Kuthulos, hid him behind a drape, and stole his robes. Under Kuthulos' guise, Thulsa Doom, and send Kull to his doom at the Enchanted Domain under a false pretense, while Kuthulos heard, powerless. Escaping doom, Kull returned and was informed that "Kuthulos", rather than Delcardes or Saremes, were to blame for his ordeal. Confronted, Thulsa Doom revealed a captive Kuthulos hidden behind a drape at Delcardes' house, before revealing his true self, before leaving. Kull bore no ill will towards Kuthulos for his forced role in Delcardes' plot, and welcomed him as a a new confidant. After a journey in the mountains, Kull, Brule, Ka-Nu, Kuthulos and the Red Slayers returned to the City of Wonders and stumbled a castle, the Skull of Silence, in the hills of Zalgara. Still many years away from the City of Wonders, Ka-Nu proposed to spent the night. Kutuhulos opposed the notion, recounting the Skull of Silence's story, and the imprisonment there of the Spectre of Silence by Raama. Despite Ka-Nu's and Kuthulos' warnings, Kull broke the chains on the door of the Castle, unleashing the Spectre, which Kull was able to force back before sealing the Skull of Silence once more. Later, Kuthulos was part of the party of the Valusian expedition against the Lemurian pirates. Returning home, the two of five vessels originally gone lost themselves in unmapped waters. Kuthulos notified Kull that they were seemingly on the island where dwelt the Cult of the Leopard. They were welcomed by Dom Vinsala. Due to his methods to quell unrest (which was strengthened by the attacks of Demontur (a man cursed by lycanthropy), Kull, Brule and Kuthulos soon agreed that Vinsala was aggravating the situation. After the isle's people, reinforced by Kull's forces and with the help of Demontur, defeated Vinsala, the Valusians returned home. During the plague, Kuthulos remained within the palace, playing wizard and sorcerer with Brule. When Brule evoked a tale of his home that was reminiscent of his game with Kuthulos, Kull had his circle tell tales to pass time. Kuthulos himself recounted the tale of Yagotha, and how the Old Ones had almost settled in Zalgara more than ten thousands of years ago. Later, Kuthulos discussed of the inexplicable yet real event of the Goblin Moon with Kull. When Kull was missing, Kuthulos agreed with Gonar and Brule to have the time-displaced Conan impersonate the Valusian monarch.
abilities: Kuthulos was a scholar. Additionally, he was seemingly a ventriloquist, speaking in Saremes' stead.

kwabena ware.name: Kwabena Ware
kwabena ware.origin: Kwabena Ware was a Wakanda disillusioned with his king Black Panther following the different tragedies that struck the nation. His village was flooded when the Phoenix-empowered Namor attacked the country, and his brother Kwaku died later on at the hands of the Black Order. Believing that the Black Panther was ignoring the needs of the nation, Kwabena joined the insurgent group known as The People. He was outfitted with repulsor tech and turned into a suicide bomber by the People's ally Zeke Stane. thumb|left The Black Panther abducted Kwabena together with numerous other unconscious suicide bombers when he raided several of the People's bases. When Black Panther was analysing him, Kwabena awoke and berated his king. However, Black Panther refuted Kwabena's claims and even convinced him to abandon the People's cause and their nefarious methods. T'Challa later had Kwabena released and return to one of the People's bases disguised as a soldier so as to look for Ezekiel Stane, while using his soul-searching powers to find them as soon as they came in contact. Once this happened, Black Panther attacked the People alone and appeared to be captured, but in reality, used the opportunity to record Stane confessing that the People's leader Tetu promised him a part of Wakanda for his help. Panther's allies Manifold, Luke Cage, Storm and Misty Knight teleported into the base and defeated the People, though Stane and his allies the Fenris Twins managed to escape. Kwabena Ware joined the fight against the People when they mobilized towards the Golden City. When Black Panther decided to seek assistance from the souls in Necropolis, one of the dead spirits was that of Kwaku Ware. When the People was defeated and before the spirits departed from the physical world, Kwabena shared a brief moment with his brother. Kwabena was later considered by Black Panther as a potential recruit to replenish the Hatut Zeraze.

kwai chang.name: Kwai Chang
kwai chang.origin: Kwai Chang was a member of the Golden Tigers, a Chinatown-based gang operating under the command of Chaka Khan. Chang joined Teng, Chen-Wu, and other top enforcers in a coordinated assault on the Meachum Building. Acting under Chaka’s direct leadership, the Golden Tigers sought to overwhelm the premises and assert dominance in their ongoing conflict. Their offensive was swiftly countered by Iron Fist. Despite their numbers and preparation, Chang and his fellow Tigers were decisively outmatched. Iron Fist dismantled the attack with minimal difficulty, leading to the eventual apprehension of the gang members involved.

kwai far.name: Kwai Far
kwai far.origin: Kwai Far is the daughter of Fu Manchu, now going by the name Han, and an unknown woman. She was raised with the intent to act as a bridge between the nations of China and Wakanda. Black Panther and Luke Cage came to negotiate when Han unveiled Kwai Far to the former as a bride for him. Black Panther admitted that she was beautiful, no doubt, but was already in love with someone else. This angered Han who slapped his daughter for failing to seduce the King of Wakanda. As Han sent his man after the two, they were aided by the unexpected arrival of Shang-Chi who had come to rescue his sister. Afterwards, Kwai Far admitted that she was, in fact, in love with Black Panther and did not mind simply going on a date with him. Both Shang-Chi and Luke Cage even managed to get Black Panther to consider it. However, Kwai Far was turned down and has not been seen since.

kyklops.name: Kyklops
kyklops.origin: The Kyklops was a massive robot super weapon that was designed by the Enclave and unleashed on New York as the Enclave was taking external damage. The war machine's reign of terror was stopped when the Incredible Hulk appeared and assaulted the robot, throwing vehicles at its massive optic, and throwing its foot when it attempted to stomp on him. Eventually Hulk managed to tear the robot apart, destroying it. The Enclave would send an army of other weaker Kyklops to attack high priority targets and guard major locations, though they too were destroyed by either the Hulk or the U.S. Army.

kyknos.name: Kyknos
kyknos.species: Half-human demigod son of the Greek God Ares and a mortal woman
kyknos.origin: Kyknos was the son of the mortal Mycenaean princess Pelopia and of Ares, the Greek God of war. He decided to build a temple to his father, but during this effort he was killed by Hercules, thus sparking Ares' long-standing rivalry with the Prince of Power. Kyknos went to Hades when he died, and remained there for thousands of years. When Hercules journeyed to the underworld to recover Zeus, Kyknos was part of the jury that Hercules had to beat to free him. During Norman Osborn's period in power, Hera came to Hades and recruited Kyknos to be her new god of war. In exchange, all he had to do was kill his father. Kyknos agreed, but was killed by his father.

kyle brock.name: Kyle Brock
kyle brock.species: Granted superhuman powers and abilities by an ancient Egyptian god
kyle brock.origin: Kyle Brock was an NYPD officer on duty when he was shot by criminals and left to die. He was brought to a New York hospital where he was taken by the Egyptian god of death, Seth, and given a second chance. Seth needed his Asgardian enemy, Hogun the Grim, to join him permanently in the realm of death, so he tried to trick Brock and his companions into ending his life. Kyle Brock would be rewarded by being made whole once more able to live out his life with his wife and family. Seth knew that a mortal could never accomplish this task so he gave Brock the incredible powers of Earth Lord. The punishment for failing his mission would return Brock to the death god's realm forever. As Earth Lord and his teammates fought the Thunder god, Thor, who was protecting Hogun, he had doubts about what he was doing and decided to rethink his position. He and the other members of Earth Force left the scene only to return with the hope that they may join Thor in his fight against Seth. Together with some of the most powerful beings in the universe, Earth Lord turned on his former master. Seth believed that with enough time Earth Lord may have been able to defeat him, but Seth wasn't about to give him that luxury. Earth Force was no match for their former master and was left to die. Seth was eventually defeated and Earth Lord along with the members of Earth Force was healed by the other Heliopolitan gods and was returned to Earth. Sometime after Brock was released from the hospital, he and his partner trailed a gang known as the Bloody Claws to an apartment building. In a hail of gunfire Brock's partner was shot and believed he would die. This made Brock think of his near-death experience which endowed him with the power of Earth Lord. As his partner fell unconscious, Brock grabbed the sign of Aton that was tattooed in his palm and made the stunning transformation into Earth Lord. The Bloody Claws were no match for Earth Lord's power and were quickly subdued. Now that the gang was finished and Brock's partner was safe, he shouted over the rooftops that Earth Lord was here to stay. Brock was eventually called to a location, along with other police units, when Bloodaxe seemed to be running amok and endangering an innocent woman's life. The special task force Code: Blue was called in to deal with this super powered menace, but Brock knew they wouldn't be able to stop Bloodaxe alone. When no one was looking, Brock transformed himself into the giant Earth Lord and sent a signal to the other members of Earth Force, Skyhawk and Wind Warrior. Earth Lord engaged Bloodaxe on his own, which enabled police to rescue the woman, Susan Austin, but his teammates soon showed up to assist. Together Earth Force, Code: Blue and a little help from the astral form of Doctor Strange were able to stop the menace of Bloodaxe. The current whereabouts of Earth Lord are unknown.

kyle dansig.name: Kyle Dansig
kyle dansig.origin: Kyle Dansig was an FBI agent working as part of the Project Chimera, a organization made to capture and brainwash mutants into government agents, run by Virus. When a team of mutants led by Logan started raiding Project Chimera bases and freeing mutant prisoners, including Dansig's own sons Shadowshift and Scout, Virus sent Bolivar Trask's Sentinels against the team. When the Sentinels attacked Logan's team's stronghold, Dansig had a change of heart, running into the flames to save his sons. Charles Xavier covered their escape, making all the surrounding government agents think the three of them perished in the fire.

kyle grobe.name: Kyle Grobe
kyle grobe.origin: In the year 2092 of Earth-9485 (a divergent Earth-928), Kyle Grobe and his son Darrion were working on a project for the technology company Alchemax involving time travel by creating a protective armor called a "time shell." The two discovered a dimension comprised of kinetic energy (the same dimension from which the hero Speedball drew his powers), and Darrion suggested this would be an alternative to the time shell, as time had no meaning within the dimension. However, his father refused, and, in the process of rushing the project to completion, Kyle Grobe was swept into the time stream and merged with the time shell, dying himself and creating the techno-organic being called Advent. As Advent, Kyle Grobe manipulated the past to change his future. His son, Darrion, protected from the alteration by having creating a pocket reality during the experiment, was determined to fix the mess his father created. He found Speedball in the kinetic dimension and created a duplicate body of the hero, transferred his own consciousness into it, and replaced Speedball with the duplicate. For some time, Darrion lived as Speedball and with Speedball's teammates, the New Warriors. However, Darrion's presence created chaos with time itself, and the villainous Sphinx confronted the New Warriors, ultimately drawing Advent to the scene. The Sphinx killed the Speedball duplicate and he and Advent escaped. The Warrior Timeslip was with the duplicate as it died, and she received Darrion's memories. Timeslip used her knowledge and powers to transport the New Warriors to the future. There, a holographic persona of Darrion further helped the Warriors to undo all of Advent's manipulations. Ultimately, the team had to enter the kinetic dimension and join the true Speedball in defeating Advent before returning home.

kyle lacon.name: Kyle Lacon
kyle lacon.origin: Kyle Lacon was the member of a biker gang in New York City. He hired Deadpool to kill one of his fellow gang members, Rocko. Klye and Deadpool staged an encounter with the gang at a local cinema, and Deadpool confronted Rocko. After killing Rocko, Deadpool had Kyle fill out the necessary paperwork, and tried to charge him a penalty fee for not having disclosed in advance that Rocko was a superhuman. When Kyle refused, Deadpool stole his motorbike. Kyle was left with the rest of the gang, who beat him up for having put a hit out on Rocko.
